    The ask

    We’re asking our school to offer biodegradable utensils in the cafeteria instead of disposable plastic ones. It’s a simple, practical change—and every signature helps show that students care about what happens after lunch.

    A student-led request

    Make the better choice the easy choice.

    We’re asking cafeteria decision-makers to make biodegradable utensils available at lunch. Add your name, then pass the petition to someone who cares about a lighter footprint, too.
